de.reason: Two senses of one English word, each sourced separately in `docs/i18n/de/glossary.md`. `Durchsuchen…` is the button that opens the system file picker (`servers.sheet.browse`, `settings.adb.browse`), taken from Finder's own `ConnectToWindow.strings` `48.title`. `Durchsehen` is the archives segmented cell (`settings.archives.opt.browse`), which means step INTO the archive and list it like a folder (KDE Dolphin, "Archive durchsehen"). The archive sense cannot take `Durchsuchen`: that is the settled scan/search verb ("Laufwerk wird durchsucht …"), so merging them would tell the reader the app is searching the archive.

nl.reason: `Terug` is the standalone back button in a list you drill into (network browser, share list, mount sheet). `Vorige` is the paired previous/next of the Go menu and the onboarding wizard, where macOS Dutch pairs `Vorige` with `Volgende`. See `docs/i18n/nl/terms.json` `back`.
`Aanmaakdatum` is Finder's column header (Date Created); the date balloon lists participles (`Aangemaakt`, `Laatst gewijzigd`, `Laatst geopend`), so it takes the participle.
`Gereed` is an operation's lifecycle status (macOS AppKit Done → Gereed). `Klaar` is the word a screen reader appends to a finished checklist step, where a plain adjective reads right.

The menu bar's Edit menu is Apple's own title `Wijzig`; F4 and the context-menu item open a file in an editor, which this catalog names `Bewerk`. Never replace a menu-bar title with the ordinary word.
The menu bar's File menu is Apple's own Dutch title `Archief`; the suggested-ops column names an ordinary file, `Bestand`.
`Van` / `Naar` are a paired heading set in the transfer dialog (Total Commander and Double Commander nl). `Vanuit:` is the inline label in front of a source path during the scan phase.
`Bewerkingsdatum` is Finder's Date Modified column and the date filters. The keyboard-shortcuts filter means shortcuts the user changed, with no date involved, so it takes `Gewijzigd`.
`Bezig` is an operation or task in progress (the queue's state word). `Actief` is a local AI server process that is up, which Dutch doesn't call `bezig`.
`Zoek` is the button that starts a search (bare-stem imperative, macOS Search → Zoek). `Zoeken` names the feature: the window title, the Settings section, the onboarding feature row.

`Selecteer` is the menu-bar menu for file selection (imperative). `Selecteren` is the onboarding feature-row name, parallel to `Zoeken`. `Kies` is the dropdown placeholder, where the user picks an option rather than selecting files.
Buttons and menu items take the bare-stem imperative `Verstuur foutrapport`; the dialog title takes the infinitive `Foutrapport versturen`, the house form for window titles.
Buttons and menu items take the imperative `Verstuur feedback`; the dialog title takes the infinitive `Feedback versturen`.
The button takes the imperative `Verstuur rapport`; the crash dialog's title takes the infinitive `Rapport versturen`.
The View-menu item is the imperative `Toon verborgen bestanden`; the Settings checkbox label is infinitive-last, `Verborgen bestanden tonen`, the house form of every settings label.

Three different actions: `Herstel` is Apple's Edit > Undo (text undo, must match macOS); `Zet terug` is Finder's Put Back, which the trash toast literally performs; `Ongedaan maken` reverts an Ask Cmdr rename run.
The menu bar's View menu is Apple's own title `Weergave`; F3 and the File-menu item show a file, which is `Toon`.
`Zoom` is Cmdr's text zoom submenu; the Window menu's Zoom item (fill the screen) is Apple's own Dutch title `Vergroot/verklein`.

pt.reason: Two senses of one English word, each sourced separately in `docs/i18n/pt/glossary.md`. `Escolher…` is the button that opens the system file picker (`servers.sheet.browse`, `settings.adb.browse`), taken from Apple's own `Choose…` → `Escolher…`. `Navegar` is the archives segmented cell (`settings.archives.opt.browse`), which means step inside and list like a folder (macOS Finder VoiceOver, Total Commander pt-BR). Apple never says `Navegar` for picking a file, and the archive sense is never `Escolher`, so one word for both would be wrong on whichever surface lost.

zh-Hant.reason: Two senses of one English word. The Settings colour options mean the app AS A SOURCE of a colour (kept as the Latin `App`, per the brand-word rule); the shortcuts scope means `in-app`, which needs `App 內` to contrast with the system-wide scope beside it.

`返回` is navigation back (history, network browser, the Go menu). The onboarding wizard's `上一步` is the previous STEP of a sequence, which Traditional Chinese names differently; `返回` there would suggest leaving the wizard.

`兩者` answers `which of these two?` in the search type filter. The notification setting asks WHERE to notify and picks both channels, so it reads as `兩者都用` (use both), which is a verb phrase, not an enumeration.

`完成` is the visually-hidden word a screen reader appends to a finished checklist step (`Find files. Done.`), where a bare adjective is right. `已完成` is an operation's lifecycle status in the log, where the perfective aspect marks a finished run.

`修改日期` is the Finder column header and the date filters, where `Modified` abbreviates `Date modified`. The keyboard-shortcuts filter chip means `commands whose shortcut YOU changed`, with no date involved, so it takes `已修改`.

Total Commander, the source the glossary already cites for the full `正規表示式`, ships its own short chip `正規式` (WCMD.LNG IDs 5615/6626). The search-mode chips are tight and take it; `viewer.search.regex` is an aria label plus tooltip whose visible text is the fixed `.*` glyph, so it has room for the full form and a screen reader wants it. Bare `正規` is banned in both: it's a bound morpheme, and Microsoft's only `正規*` entries are `正規化` = normalization.
`執行中` is a local AI server PROCESS that is up. `進行中` is an operation in progress in the log. Traditional Chinese splits these; a running process is not a task making progress.

The spinner tooltip renders `Scanning…` and takes the progressive `正在掃描…`. The progress dialog's step chip is a two-word stage NAME in a fixed-width indicator, so it takes the bare `掃描`, matching the other stage chips beside it.

`選取` is the menu-bar Select menu and the verb. `ui.select.placeholder` is the empty state of a dropdown, which Traditional Chinese phrases as an invitation (`請選擇`, please choose) rather than a bare verb.

The crash dialog's TITLE asks the question (`要傳送報告嗎`), which is the house pattern for a confirming dialog title in this catalog; the button below it is the bare action `傳送報告`. English reuses one string for both surfaces.

The canonical split. `檢視` is the verb: open the file viewer (F3), which is `commands.fileView` and `menu.file.view`. `menu.bar.view` is the View MENU, which macOS Traditional calls `顯示方式` (display mode) because it holds the view-mode choices. Merging them would rename either the F3 command or the menu.

The status-bar selection summary drops the measure word (`{目錄}`) because it composes as `3 / 10 目錄` with a `/` connector already separating the numbers; the scan stats render a bare tally (`4 個目錄`) and need it. Same word, two grammatical frames.
Same frame split as the `dirs` noun above: `{檔案}` in the `/`-connected status-bar summary, `{個檔案}` after a bare tally in the delete and transfer scan stats.
